name: I Want To Wear Your Wool
source:
As spring arrives, Fable the wolf wants to turn over a new leaf and make friends with the other animals in the glade. Along the way, they meet a sheep who is a little too eager to be eaten.

[From [url=https://cuteshadow.itch.io/i-want-to-wear-your-wool]itch.io[/url]]
